source_review: Personally viewed all 13 fam-00 through fam-12 source images during research and compared these final five views to them. Private research-next-after-nycu/north-shelter/source-manifest.json binds those sources; no raw photos included in public artifact.
confirmed: Complete asymmetrical rounded white shell: left curl and projecting seat, right solid wall to ground, not mirrored
Tall left through-slot and open underside of rolled seat preserved
L/return seating with right downturned end and central return support, not filled pedestal
Four rear thin frames and three rear glazing bays, four forward-curved roof arms and three roof panes
Roof/front edge step and separation between white shell and upper transparent canopy
Front and side negative spaces retained; rear view properly reverses asymmetry
limitations: Observational 2007 published appearance, not measured restoration or asserted 2026 condition
Exact curves, dimensions, thin component thicknesses, glazing slopes/gaps and minor fixtures are simplified or inferred
Glass is six represented sheet regions, not six detached separately printable components; alpha in Blend/3MF render does not imply physical transparency of opaque STL printing
Source diagrams are exploded representation; final model does not duplicate hidden internal skeleton as exposed frames
Display plinth is added and not claimed as measured site boundary; no actual print or support-free certification
verdict: No source-based blocking exterior discrepancy found. Five views show the distinctive main topology rather than only a front facade. Approval is visual/source-bound, not a substitute for geometric or print QA.
